description.zh: 迁移源描述。长度为0~256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
description.en: The description of the migration source. The description can be up to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh: 迁移源名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。
description.en: The name of the migration source. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character, and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. The name can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).
The ID of the migration source.

title.zh: 修改一个迁移源的名称和描述

descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明

使用该API修改迁移源的名称和描述时，对迁移源的状态没有要求。
descriptions.en:
## Description

You can modify the name and description of a migration source regardless of its status.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun smc modify-source-server-attribute --source-id s-bp17m1vi6x20c6g60000 --name testSourceServerName --description This_is_a_source_server. --region cn-hangzhou
